topic: Using EMMA - Researching Municipal Securities and 529 Plans
source_evidence:
Financial disclosure documents from the issuer of the bond
Other ongoing disclosure documents about events affecting the bond
answer: EMMA provides free public access to municipal securities documents, including financial disclosures from a bond’s issuer and ongoing disclosures about events affecting the bond. When researching a municipal security, these are two types of disclosure documents you can look for on EMMA.
